title: 第23章 夫唯不争故天下莫之与能争第24章 高筑墙广积粮缓称王
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姜云天与青鸳等人修炼阴阳合神功以来，每次都有所感悟与精进。
他对自己的修炼也有了不小的信心，做为一个小白，每一次的精进与体会，是他刚到这里时完全不同的。
与他在蓝星的生活是天差地别，至少现在的修炼要比工作相对简单一些，不像那么多的多变和繁琐。
姜云天与青鸳全力修炼了一个多时辰，青鸳与姜云在阴阳合神功的运行下，越来越默契，行云流水。
青鸳对姜云天道：“你尽力帮助她，必须要青莲在今天完成修炼，习得神功。”
姜云天道：“必不辱使命。”
青莲学着青鸳的模样，此时，姜云天将青莲引导开始修炼神功。
在她们俩人开始的以后，青鸳三女离开。
回宗族回报了。
她们出色地完成了宗族交给任务。
这次青莲的事，与姜云浩的中毒也是惊到了青府众人，如果不能把事情处理好，那就是将青莲推进了姜家的火坑了。
现在已经有了更好的理由与说辞，她们也就可以有交代了。
姜云天现在意念通达，他想到在蓝星时团建时导师讲的一句话，夫唯不争，故天下莫之与能争。
要不是他一再退让，怎么能获得几女芳心。
更不会有现在这么好的的结果，他还真是担心青府的女子们会做出什么事来。
心中念道：“古人诚不欺我。”
小狸好奇心总是得不到满足，她在观摩，也在修练神功。
看到姜云天他们在那里的样子，她心有神往，期期艾艾。
在姜云天和青莲修炼了一时辰后，青莲在神功的帮助下，又是更上一层楼，又晋升了一个小境界。
姜云天的阴阳鱼也快速旋转。

一个阴阳鱼从他的丹田中飞出，像复制一样，落在了青莲的丹田里，然后上升，进入她的灵台，在元婴小人的腹部上烙印了上去。
接着枝桠上木灵果的枝桠上一棵木灵果，从枝桠上慢慢脱落，紧接着，阴阳鱼快速旋转，阴阳化神丹慢慢推出。
姜云天看到此处，快速将阴阳化神丹和木灵果推出，青莲看了一眼，服下木灵果。
她的修为开始爆涨，以肉眼可见的速度攀升级，一直到元婴九重巅峰才停下。
青莲在感受到自己的修为快速攀升，心中喜不自胜。
看到姜云天对她笑，低下头，翩然离去。
他也要回宗族长老那里汇报，她成功了，她成了姜云天的道侣，还有她获得了一个她看不懂的东西，要回去请教，她本想和姜云天分享，看到姜云天有些累了，不忍打扰，这才悄然离去。
青莲离开以后，姜云天躺在床上，他懒得动，回想着四女的修炼过程。
也回想自己在蓝星的生活，和那个996工作的自己，完全是两种生活。
这边的生活虽然有压力，但更让他有了上进之心。
正在姜云天心飞天外，快乐畅游之际，经过几个周天练习的小狸已化身成了虎豹纹美女，姜云天眼睛一睁，看到小狸，见猎心喜。
小狸将她观摩的各种修炼方式与姜云天都试了试，这可把姜云天高兴坏了。
这就是他喜欢的样子，小狸的野性之美。
在与小狸修炼了几个时辰以后，，姜云天感到一种修为禁锢松动的感觉。
content_en:
Since Jiang Yuntian, Qing Yuan and others practiced the yin and yang combination of magic skills, they have gained insights and improved every time.
He also has a lot of confidence in his own cultivation. As a novice, his efforts and experiences every time are completely different from when he first arrived here.
It was completely different from his life on Blue Star. At least his current cultivation was relatively simpler than work, not as changeable and cumbersome.
Jiang Yuntian and Qing Yuan practiced with all their strength for more than an hour. Under the operation of the yin and yang combined magic skills, Qing Yuan and Jiang Yun became more and more tacit and smooth.
Qing Yuan said to Jiang Yuntian: "You try your best to help her. You must make Qing Lian complete her training today and acquire magical skills."
Jiang Yuntian said: "We will definitely fulfill our mission."
Qinglian imitated Qingyuan's appearance. At this time, Jiang Yuntian guided Qinglian to start practicing magical skills.
After the two of them started talking, the three Qingyuan girls left.
Returned to the clan and reported back.
They completed the tasks assigned by their clan brilliantly.
This time Qinglian's incident and Jiang Yunhao's poisoning also shocked everyone in Qingfu. If they can't handle the matter well, Qinglian will be pushed into the Jiang family's fire pit.
Now that they have better reasons and rhetoric, they can give an explanation.
Jiang Yuntian's mind was clear now, and he thought of what his mentor said during the team building in Blue Star: "You can't fight with me, so no one in the world can fight with you."
If he hadn't repeatedly given in, how could he have won the hearts of several women?
Not to mention that there would not be such a good result now. He was really worried about what the women in Qingfu would do.
I thought in my heart: "The ancients will never deceive me."
Xiaoli's curiosity is never satisfied. She is observing and practicing magical skills.
Seeing Jiang Yuntian and the others there, she felt fascinated and moved every moment.
After Jiang Yuntian and Qinglian practiced for an hour, Qinglian, with the help of magical skills, reached a higher level and advanced to a small realm.
Jiang Yuntian's Yin Yang fish also rotated rapidly.
A yin-yang fish flew out of his dantian and landed in Qinglian's dantian like a copy. Then it rose up, entered her spiritual platform, and imprinted itself on the abdomen of the Nascent Soul villain.
Then the wood spirit fruit on the branch slowly fell off from the branch. Then, the yin and yang fish rotated quickly, and the yin and yang magic pill was slowly pushed out.
When Jiang Yuntian saw this, he quickly pushed out the Yin Yang Transformation Pill and the Wood Spirit Fruit. Qinglian took a look at it and took the Wood Spirit Fruit.
Her cultivation level began to skyrocket, climbing up the level at a speed visible to the naked eye, and did not stop until she reached the peak of the ninth level of Nascent Soul.
Qinglian was overjoyed when she felt her cultivation level rising rapidly.
Seeing Jiang Yuntian smiling at her, he lowered his head and left gracefully.
He also wanted to go back to the clan elders to report that she succeeded, she became Jiang Yuntian's Taoist companion, and she got something she couldn't understand. She wanted to go back and ask for advice. She originally wanted to share it with Jiang Yuntian, but when she saw that Jiang Yuntian was a little tired, she couldn't bear to disturb him, so she left quietly.
After Qinglian left, Jiang Yuntian lay on the bed, too lazy to move, thinking about the four girls' cultivation process.
I also think back to my life at Blue Star, which is completely different from the life I had when I was working in 996.
Although life here is stressful, it makes him more motivated.
When Jiang Yuntian was feeling very happy and swimming happily, Xiaoli, who had practiced for several days, had transformed into a tiger and leopard-print beauty. Jiang Yuntian opened his eyes and saw Xiaoli, and he was very happy to see Xiaoli.
Xiaoli tried all the various cultivation methods she observed with Jiang Yuntian, which made Jiang Yuntian extremely happy.
This is what he likes, the wild beauty of the little raccoon dog.
After practicing with Xiaoli for a few hours, Jiang Yuntian felt a feeling that the prison of his cultivation was loosening.
